title: [Master]-]VAT Settlement G/L Entries Do Not Populate Source Currency Amount and Source VAT Currency Amount After Running Calculate and Post VAT Settlement
summary: The Calculate and Post VAT Settlement report now correctly populates source currency amount and source VAT currency amount fields in VAT settlement G/L entries, fixing missing values that appeared after the settlement process ran.
key_points: Source currency amount fields were not being set during VAT settlement calculations
Source VAT currency amount fields were also missing from posted entries
Report 20 (Calc. and Post VAT Settlement) was updated across multiple localized versions
Tests were added to verify correct population of currency amount fields
